description: Raked bow, expanded (W1x): the port/starboard halves and inserts are AUTHORED counterparts (not translated standard halves, per the kit README) so the taper toward the single approved stem is baked at authoring time; the carved prow is UNCHANGED. Standard_Bow_Halves (the kit's other bow-half set, for a standard-width bow using the same rig) is NOT used here -- see docs/EXPANDED-HULL-VALIDATION.md.
boundsNote: X/Z UNCHANGED from hull.bow.w1r2.v3 (length/depth not touched by this kit; the stem and prow are explicitly unchanged per the kit README). Y is the AFT (full-beam) extreme, DERIVED not measured -- see hull.stern.w1x.v1's boundsNote; the bow narrows toward the stem so most of the hull is narrower than this union box.

sockets.notes: UNCHANGED from hull.bow.w1r2.v3 (README: 'carved prow remains unchanged', inserts taper toward 'the single approved stem'). Not independently re-measured from the FBX (see hull.stern.w1x.v1's boundsNote on the per-part axis-metadata issue found during measurement); carried over from W1-r2's own hand-measured value. Confirmed indirectly: the assembled-midpoint chimney cross-check (hull.stern.w1x.v1's Chimney socket notes) only reproduces the kit's own fittings.chimney_position if the bow's physics length is unchanged, which requires this stem X to be unchanged too.
Tip of the decorative prow; not a join. UNCHANGED (README: prow unchanged).
Y moved outboard from W1-r2's 3.45 by +1.4; see docs/EXPANDED-HULL-VALIDATION.md 'Gun slots'. Close to the aft join (full beam here; the taper starts further forward, same as W1-r2's own bow slots).
Y moved outboard by +1.4; see DeckSlot_0_-1.
